slides.texte_overlay:
The Law of
Compound Habits:
What you do every day
matters more than what you
do once in a while. Ten pages,
ten push-ups, ten minutes.
In five years, it's a different man.

The Law of
Small Circles:
You'll go from twenty friends
to four. That's not losing.
That's finding out who stays.

The Law of
Delayed Proof:
You'll work for months
with nothing to show.
The results come late,
then all at once.

The Law of
Borrowed Time:
Your parents are getting older
while you're getting busier.
Call. Visit. Ask their stories
while you still can.

The Law of
the Comfort Trap:
The bed, the feed, the same
weekend every weekend.
Comfort feels safe.
It's where years disappear.

The Law of
the Honest No:
Every yes to the wrong thing
is a no to your own plans.
Say it once. Say it kindly.
Mean it.

The Law of
Curiosity:
The men who keep learning
never get stuck.
Stay curious, every day.
